description: This file implements the DisplayHandler class for managing WebRTC display frames, handling display creation and destruction events, frame processing, and periodic frame repetition in a WebRTC streaming context within the Cuttlefish project.

classes.name: DisplayHandler
classes.description: Handles WebRTC display streaming, manages display events, frame processing, and periodic frame updates.

methods.name: DisplayHandler
methods.description: Constructor initializing the display handler with references to streamer, screenshot handler, screen connector, and optional composition manager.

methods.name: ~DisplayHandler
methods.description: Destructor that stops the frame repeater thread safely.

methods.name: GetScreenConnectorCallback
methods.description: Returns a callback function to process frames from the screen connector, converting pixel formats to I420.

methods.name: Loop
methods.description: Main loop that continuously processes frames from the screen connector and updates the last frame buffers.

methods.name: SendLastFrame
methods.description: Resends the last frame for a specific display or all displays.

methods.name: SendBuffers
methods.description: Sends a batch of buffers to the display sinks, updating timestamps.

methods.name: RepeatFramesPeriodically
methods.description: Periodically repeats frames to maintain streaming at a fixed interval.

methods.name: AddDisplayClient
methods.description: Increments active client count and starts the repeater if needed.
